answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 83 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a nectar bet on surviving 83 epochs of grading, and every oasis settlement recomputes the dune schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 31 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
